subject: English
title: 英文第41題｜avoid的上下文語意
question:
What does avoid mean?
(A) To keep away from.
(B) To enjoy.
(C) To begin.
(D) To remember.
explanation: Lucy說I avoid taking Mary to supermarkets because they are too noisy for her，意思是因為超市對Mary太吵，會避免帶她去。後文安靜時段符合需要，便打算帶她前往，也支持avoid是「避免、避開」，選A To keep away from。原句avoid後接taking這個V-ing形式。B享受、C開始、D記得都不符合因為太吵而暫時避開的語境。她避免的是帶Mary到嘈雜的環境，不是在避免或排斥Mary本人。

optionAnalysis.label: A
optionAnalysis.explanation: avoid有避免、避開之意，符合因太吵而暫不前往。

optionAnalysis.label: B
optionAnalysis.explanation: enjoy是享受，與避開噪音語境不合。

optionAnalysis.label: C
optionAnalysis.explanation: begin是開始，不能表達本句因太吵而不去。

optionAnalysis.label: D
optionAnalysis.explanation: remember是記得，與上下文行為原因不同。

passage:
Happy Group (9)

Jim
Good news! Since this September, Sunshine Supermarket on Park Street has had a “quiet hour” between 10:30 and 11:30 on Wednesdays for people with autism. This is because they struggle with loud music and noise in a store. During this hour, the clerk will turn off TVs and music, so they will be able to shop more comfortably. What do you think of the news?

Lucy
Thank you, Jim. I avoid taking Mary to supermarkets because they are too noisy for her. I think the quiet hour in the supermarket is what we need. I'll take her there on a Wednesday morning.

Carrie
I don't think an hour is enough. What's more, 10:30–11:30 a.m. is an office hour. Though a “quiet hour” is what I've been waiting for years, how can I shop at Sunshine Supermarket at that time?

Mark
I don't agree with Carrie. The “quiet hour” is a good start to be friendly to those with autism. I hope more and more stores will care about people with special needs. I'll share the news with my boss. Maybe there will be a “quiet hour” in our bakery for people with autism.

Kent
Mark is right. People with autism and their family need support. We should all help them live a better life. I think Sunshine Supermarket is doing the right thing.

字詞：autism 自閉症；struggle 掙扎；support 支持。
verificationNote: 已實看原卷本題、完整四選項及閱讀材料；原問以外的小題不收入。
trap: 依完整句型或上下文核對，不只抓一個單字或數字。

teachingComic.title: avoid要連原因與後文一起讀

panels.heading: ① 太吵，因而避免帶Mary前往
panels.text: Lucy說超市對Mary太吵，所以avoid taking Mary to supermarkets表示避免帶她去這類嘈雜環境，不是享受或開始去。
panels.alt: 新製兩名家人在繁忙超市入口觀察的平靜情境，不替人物貼診斷或畫驚恐失控。

panels.heading: ② 避開環境，不是在排斥Mary
panels.text: avoid在此是避免、避開，對應A To keep away from。圖示兩人一起離開不合適的場所，並不是一人躲開另一個人。
panels.alt: 同兩人一起轉向較安靜路徑的新情境，沒有排斥他人或把障礙當危險。

panels.heading: ③ 安靜時段，又願意帶她去
panels.text: 後文Lucy要在週三安靜時段帶Mary去購物，支持前面是為避開噪音。avoid後接taking這個V-ing形式，也應一起記住。
panels.alt: 新製兩人在較安靜超市自在購物的情境，不用模型寫星期或醫療說明。

fourth.answer: 答案 A：To keep away from.
points: too noisy是避免前往的原因。
安靜時段願意再去，前後文互證。
